result: Lean module FermionSignHubbardProtected compiles cleanly under Lean 4.35.0 with pinned Mathlib (commit 56a005855ea17e0b0958f73ec801ae140b0a1679). All printed axioms are a subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} with zero sorry, admit, custom axioms, native_decide, or unsafe.
proof_boundary: States arithmetic consequences of the pairing relations (nonnegativity of C*(d*d) for C >= 0, and of d_up*d_down when d_down = d_up/det_P with det_P > 0) and the negative product of two stored rational pairs (masks 15721 and 1281). The pairing relations and the identification of the stored pairs with det(I+P_sigma) of the Hubbard transfer matrices are not derived in Lean; the pairs are recomputed by checks/independent/fsp-hubbard-protected-representations.py.
